pet-honey-bear-bottle-320ml.headline: 320 ml Bear Bottle for Branded Honey Lines
pet-honey-bear-bottle-320ml.application: Build a branded honey pack around the sculpted bear and its front label panel. The flip-top presentation suits honey served directly from the bottle.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-320ml.artwork: Keep the face and paws visible and check the front label against the panel edges on a physical sample.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-320ml.packing: Compare front-label protection and bottle orientation inside the shipping carton.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-320ml.question: How does the 320 ml bear compare with the 250 ml size?
pet-honey-bear-bottle-320ml.answer: The 320 ml bear has an approximate 450 g honey fill; the 250 ml bear has an approximate 350 g fill. Check the actual fill level, grip and shelf dimensions on both samples.

pet-honey-bear-bottle-250ml.headline: Compact Branded Packs with a Bear-Shaped Bottle
pet-honey-bear-bottle-250ml.application: The sculpted bear body and defined front panel give a smaller honey pack a recognizable shape and space for a compact product label.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-250ml.artwork: Size the artwork for the smaller front panel and check the fit on the assembled bottle.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-250ml.packing: Use the listed carton dimensions to plan the smaller bear format; agree bottle and cap packing together.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-250ml.question: Can I reuse artwork from a larger bear bottle?
pet-honey-bear-bottle-250ml.answer: You can retain the design, but adjust label width and height to the smaller panel. Proof the label on a sample to check the curved edges.

ribbed-honey-squeeze-bottle-180ml.headline: Ribbed Grip & Flat-Panel Labeling
ribbed-honey-squeeze-bottle-180ml.application: An oval body with ribbed sides provides a compact dispensing format. The flat panel accommodates a brand label while leaving the gripping area clear.
ribbed-honey-squeeze-bottle-180ml.artwork: Keep the label within the flat panel and away from the ribbed edges; evaluate the final artwork with the flip-top cap open and closed.
ribbed-honey-squeeze-bottle-180ml.packing: Confirm the carton count and bottle arrangement before calculating shipment volume.
ribbed-honey-squeeze-bottle-180ml.question: What should I check when sampling this pack?
ribbed-honey-squeeze-bottle-180ml.answer: Evaluate squeeze response, honey flow and cap resealing with your own honey. Also check the label fit on the flat panel and clearance around the open flip-top.

hexagon-honey-squeeze-bottle-360ml.headline: Faceted Bottle Design & Label Placement
hexagon-honey-squeeze-bottle-360ml.application: The pointed outlet supports directional dispensing, while the broad front and back panels accommodate separate product and information labels. The flat-sided body also creates a stable orientation for label application and shelf presentation.
hexagon-honey-squeeze-bottle-360ml.artwork: Shape the label around the sloping shoulders rather than filling the entire hexagon outline.
hexagon-honey-squeeze-bottle-360ml.packing: Account for the wide body profile and projecting cap when approving carton spacing.
hexagon-honey-squeeze-bottle-360ml.question: Does a rectangular label fit this pack?
hexagon-honey-squeeze-bottle-360ml.answer: A rectangular label may fit within the center panel. Allow for the sloping shoulders and approve the label outline on a sample before printing.

wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-370ml.headline: Wide-Mouth Access for Spoonable Honey
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-370ml.application: The wide opening provides clearance for filling equipment and convenient spoon access after opening. Its 63-400 finish supports a screw-cap and sealing arrangement suited to the approved jar assembly.
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-370ml.artwork: Check front and back label placement against the shoulders and the area immediately below the lid.
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-370ml.packing: Specify whether caps travel separately or fitted, and how the jar surfaces are protected in the carton.
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-370ml.question: Can this pack use any 63 mm lid?
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-370ml.answer: A diameter alone does not establish compatibility. Match the full 63-400 finish, cap geometry and sealing arrangement to the jar.

mini-glass-honey-jar-25ml.headline: Mini Honey Gifts, Tastings & Event Favors
mini-glass-honey-jar-25ml.application: The compact jar works well for portioned honey, tasting collections and presentation packs. Its small body benefits from a concise front label, coordinated lid artwork and a fitted protective insert.
mini-glass-honey-jar-25ml.artwork: Prioritize readable text on the small label; review a lid sticker or gift-box label if more space is needed.
mini-glass-honey-jar-25ml.packing: Approve the jar and lid inside the gift-box insert, with suitable separation for glass during transit.
mini-glass-honey-jar-25ml.question: Does 25 ml mean the jar holds 25 g of honey?
mini-glass-honey-jar-25ml.answer: No. The catalog lists 25 ml water capacity and a 35 g reference honey fill. Check the actual honey weight and headspace with a filling trial.

hexagon-glass-honey-jars.headline: Hexagon Jar Labeling & Brand Presentation
hexagon-glass-honey-jars.application: Compare three faceted glass formats for smaller branded packs and gifts. Select the size first, then place the label within its individual flat faces.
hexagon-glass-honey-jars.artwork: Give each size its own label dimensions; leave a margin before the corners so the label does not bridge the facets.
hexagon-glass-honey-jars.packing: Review separation between glass faces and lid clearance in a mixed-size gift or shipping box.
hexagon-glass-honey-jars.question: Can one label size cover all three jars?
hexagon-glass-honey-jars.answer: Each jar has its own dimensions. Keep the visual design consistent, but size and proof the label separately on each chosen model.

ribbed-glass-honey-jars.headline: Beehive Glass Jars for Branded & Gift Packs
ribbed-glass-honey-jars.application: The ribbed glass family uses a beehive-inspired profile for honey presentation. Compare the three sizes for a coordinated shelf range.
ribbed-glass-honey-jars.artwork: Work within the center panel and check whether the ribbed surface limits label height or adhesion.
ribbed-glass-honey-jars.packing: Plan dividers around the rounded profiles and use the selected model’s carton data for freight estimates.
ribbed-glass-honey-jars.question: Where should a label sit on the ribbed jar?
ribbed-glass-honey-jars.answer: Begin with the center panel. Test the artwork on the actual jar so label edges do not lift where the surface transitions into ribs.

cylindrical-honey-nozzle-bottles.headline: Cylindrical Bottle Labeling & Dispensing
cylindrical-honey-nozzle-bottles.application: Cylindrical honey bottles offer straight sides and different heights and capacities. Compare the assembled proportions with your shelf and serving space.
cylindrical-honey-nozzle-bottles.artwork: Plan the wraparound seam at the back and leave clearance below the dispensing closure.
cylindrical-honey-nozzle-bottles.packing: Carton quantities and outer dimensions vary by bottle size. Confirm the packing list for the selected format.
cylindrical-honey-nozzle-bottles.question: Do both sizes have the same dimensions and packing?
cylindrical-honey-nozzle-bottles.answer: Each size has its own height, body proportions and carton configuration. Compare the specification tables before choosing your bottle.

ribbed-pet-honey-bottles.headline: Ribbed Bottle Sizes & Label Panels
ribbed-pet-honey-bottles.application: Ribbed walls add grip and visual texture to the bottle body. The different profiles support upright dispensing formats, while the model-specific closure determines outlet style and reclosure performance.
ribbed-pet-honey-bottles.artwork: Check which panels are smooth enough for artwork; the ribs and shoulders vary across the range.
ribbed-pet-honey-bottles.packing: Use the packing data for the exact model instead of applying one carton count to the whole series.
ribbed-pet-honey-bottles.question: Can all models in this series use one cap?
ribbed-pet-honey-bottles.answer: No common cap is assumed. The listed neck finishes vary, so confirm the complete bottle-and-cap combination for each selected model.

compact-inverted-honey-bottles.headline: Cap-Down Honey Dispensing & Label Orientation
compact-inverted-honey-bottles.application: Cap-down storage keeps honey near the dispensing outlet and supports convenient serving. Base stability, valve response and clean reclosure depend on the selected body-and-cap assembly.
compact-inverted-honey-bottles.artwork: Orient the artwork for the pack’s cap-down shelf position and check front and rear label areas.
compact-inverted-honey-bottles.packing: Approve the shipping orientation and closure protection for the selected assembled pack.
compact-inverted-honey-bottles.question: Is every inverted bottle supplied with a silicone valve?
compact-inverted-honey-bottles.answer: The series name does not specify a valve. Ask for the exact closure assembly and test any proposed valve with your honey before ordering.

oval-inverted-honey-bottle.headline: Oval Cap-Down Bottle Applications
oval-inverted-honey-bottle.application: The oval body provides a broad grip area and compact shelf depth, while cap-down storage keeps honey close to the outlet. The format is intended for controlled squeeze dispensing with a compatible base closure.
oval-inverted-honey-bottle.artwork: Use the two oval faces for front and back artwork, oriented to read correctly when the bottle stands on its cap.
oval-inverted-honey-bottle.packing: Check cap support and the packed bottle’s movement within the carton.
oval-inverted-honey-bottle.question: What matters most when approving this pack?
oval-inverted-honey-bottle.answer: Check cap-down stability both full and nearly empty, then evaluate dispensing and resealing with the selected closure and your honey.

honey-jars-with-handles.headline: Larger Honey Packs with Carry Handles
honey-jars-with-handles.application: The integrated handle supports carrying and controlled pouring for larger honey packs. Filled weight, handle clearance and carton support are evaluated together for the selected jar size.
honey-jars-with-handles.artwork: Keep the main label clear of the handle’s movement and review where the handle rests against the jar.
honey-jars-with-handles.packing: Allow for the handle position, lifting load and lid clearance when specifying cartons or pallets.
honey-jars-with-handles.question: How should I choose a handle for the filled jar?
honey-jars-with-handles.answer: Approve the handle as part of the complete closure assembly. Test lifting at the intended honey weight; do not infer a load rating from an empty-jar photo.

square-pet-honey-jars.headline: Square Jar Formats for Branded Honey Lines
square-pet-honey-jars.application: Flat side panels create defined areas for front, back and side labeling. The square-style footprint supports an aligned shelf presentation for spoonable honey in two coordinated capacities.
square-pet-honey-jars.artwork: Place the primary artwork on a flat face and test the label transition around the corners.
square-pet-honey-jars.packing: Compare the footprint of each jar against your case layout before specifying a mixed range.
square-pet-honey-jars.question: What is the difference between the two sizes?
square-pet-honey-jars.answer: The capacities are 360 ml and 440 ml. Both have a 61-400 neck finish; confirm the matching cap and actual honey fill for each size.

small-wide-mouth-honey-jars.headline: Small Honey Packs with Wide-Mouth Access
small-wide-mouth-honey-jars.application: The wide opening allows straightforward filling and spoon access in a compact pack. Different cap materials and jar proportions support small honey portions, gift sets and sample collections.
small-wide-mouth-honey-jars.artwork: Keep the label below the lid and shoulder; small changes in jar height affect the available artwork space.
small-wide-mouth-honey-jars.packing: Confirm the selected closure material and whether the caps are packed separately from the jars.
small-wide-mouth-honey-jars.question: Why do the cap materials differ across the range?
small-wide-mouth-honey-jars.answer: The catalog records PP or PE for different models. Keep the cap material, liner and complete neck specification attached to the model you select.

pet-honey-bear-bottle-options.headline: Honey Bear Shapes & Label Options
pet-honey-bear-bottle-options.application: The molded bear body provides a recognizable honey presentation without relying on a full wrap label. Model-specific face details, grip proportions and front panels create different branding and serving experiences.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-options.artwork: Choose the bear profile before finalizing artwork so the label preserves the face and molded details.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-options.packing: Review each bear’s outline and cap height when planning partitions or gift packaging.
pet-honey-bear-bottle-options.question: Are these bear bottles interchangeable?
pet-honey-bear-bottle-options.answer: They have different capacities, dimensions and closure options. Choose by model and approve the label and cap on that specific bear.

pointed-cap-honey-bottles.headline: Pointed-Cap Dispensing & Bottle Selection
pointed-cap-honey-bottles.application: The tapered nozzle produces a narrower, directional honey stream. Round and shaped bodies provide different grip and squeeze responses, allowing the dispensing format to be paired with the intended pack size.
pointed-cap-honey-bottles.artwork: Check the smooth label area and the clearance needed to operate or remove the dispensing cap.
pointed-cap-honey-bottles.packing: Allow for the cap’s projection and confirm how tips are protected during shipment.
pointed-cap-honey-bottles.question: Does a pointed cap guarantee a fine honey stream?
pointed-cap-honey-bottles.answer: Flow depends on the actual outlet and your honey. Test the proposed cap and bottle together rather than selecting by cap appearance alone.

tall-pet-honey-bottles.headline: Tall Bottle Dimensions & Labeling
tall-pet-honey-bottles.application: The vertical profiles make efficient use of shelf height and provide elongated label areas. Overall height, shoulder shape and cap clearance influence filling-line handling and carton configuration.
tall-pet-honey-bottles.artwork: Use the vertical panel deliberately and check the label seam on the narrow body.
tall-pet-honey-bottles.packing: Review filled-bottle stability and carton height, especially when comparing slender models.
tall-pet-honey-bottles.question: What should I measure before choosing a tall bottle?
tall-pet-honey-bottles.answer: Provide your maximum shelf height and filling-line clearance. Compare assembled height, body dimensions and label area on the selected sample.

flat-pet-honey-bottles.headline: Front & Back Labeling on Flat Bottles
flat-pet-honey-bottles.application: Separate front and rear panels accommodate branding, ingredients and regulatory information. The shallow body depth creates a distinctive shelf profile and allows compact orientation in fitted carton layouts.
flat-pet-honey-bottles.artwork: Use separate front and back labels where appropriate, checking edges against the curved sides.
flat-pet-honey-bottles.packing: Confirm bottle orientation and spacing so broad faces are protected from scuffing.
flat-pet-honey-bottles.question: Can a wraparound label work on a flat bottle?
flat-pet-honey-bottles.answer: That depends on the side curves and label material. Test a full wrap on the selected body, or use separate front and back panels.

ribbed-wide-mouth-pet-honey-jars.headline: Wide-Mouth Filling & Ribbed Jar Labeling
ribbed-wide-mouth-pet-honey-jars.application: Ribbed or paneled walls add grip and structural detail around the jar body. The wide opening provides filling and spoon clearance, while the shoulder design defines the practical label position.
ribbed-wide-mouth-pet-honey-jars.artwork: Avoid bridging ribs with label edges; proof the artwork on the chosen jar surface.
ribbed-wide-mouth-pet-honey-jars.packing: Review the wider jar footprint and assembled cap height against the proposed carton layout.
ribbed-wide-mouth-pet-honey-jars.question: Does the wider mouth determine the sealing method?
ribbed-wide-mouth-pet-honey-jars.answer: No. The cap, liner, neck geometry and filling process determine the sealing arrangement. Specify these for the exact jar model.

honey-bear-bottle-175ml.headline: Small Honey Bear Packs with Aluminum Caps
honey-bear-bottle-175ml.application: The compact molded bear format suits smaller honey portions and presentation packs. Its front panel supports a concise label, while the aluminum closure gives the pack a contrasting metallic finish.
honey-bear-bottle-175ml.artwork: Keep the molded bear details visible and coordinate the cap finish with the front label.
honey-bear-bottle-175ml.packing: Confirm protection for the metal finish and the way caps and bottles are packed.
honey-bear-bottle-175ml.question: Is this pack a flip-top squeeze pack?
honey-bear-bottle-175ml.answer: This bottle is listed with an aluminum cap. Request the assembled sample to review opening, pouring and reclosure for your intended use.

mini-pet-honey-nozzle-bottles.headline: Small-Format Honey Dispensing
mini-pet-honey-nozzle-bottles.application: The small bodies support portioned honey packs and controlled table service. A pointed nozzle provides directional flow, while the 60 ml and 125 ml formats offer different grip and label areas.
mini-pet-honey-nozzle-bottles.artwork: Proof small text at actual size and preserve enough space to grip the bottle below the nozzle.
mini-pet-honey-nozzle-bottles.packing: Compare the carton quantity and cap clearance for each mini format before planning shipment.
mini-pet-honey-nozzle-bottles.question: Which size should I choose for a sample pack?
mini-pet-honey-nozzle-bottles.answer: Choose the intended honey weight and serving method, then compare the actual fill and dispensing on the 60 ml and 125 ml samples.

wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-shapes.headline: Jar Shape, Spoon Access & Label Placement
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-shapes.application: Each body shape provides a different balance of filling access, shoulder profile and label space. The wide openings support spoonable honey, and the varied footprints suit different shelf and gift-pack layouts.
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-shapes.artwork: Fit the artwork to each shoulder profile instead of applying one flat label template across all three jars.
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-shapes.packing: Compare the chosen jar’s outer profile with carton spacing and protection requirements.
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-shapes.question: How do I choose between the three jar shapes?
wide-mouth-pet-honey-jar-shapes.answer: Compare capacity, closure material and body dimensions, then use samples to check spoon access, label fit and shelf proportions.

screw-cap-pet-honey-jars.headline: Screw-Cap Jars for Branded & Larger Honey Packs
screw-cap-pet-honey-jars.application: Choose a smaller branded jar or a larger honey pack from this screw-cap PET range. Each listed option pairs a PET body with a PE cap; match the liner and neck finish for the selected size.
screw-cap-pet-honey-jars.artwork: Check the smooth body area below the cap and position the label seam away from primary artwork.
screw-cap-pet-honey-jars.packing: List the cap, liner and jar quantities separately when requesting a packing quotation.
screw-cap-pet-honey-jars.question: Can I order replacement lids by diameter?
screw-cap-pet-honey-jars.answer: Request the full neck and closure specification first. Similar diameters do not establish thread or sealing compatibility between these jar models.

aluminium-cap-pet-honey-jars.headline: PET Honey Jars with Metal-Finish Lids
aluminium-cap-pet-honey-jars.application: The aluminum cap creates a metallic presentation on a lightweight PET jar. The 360 ml and 730 ml formats support coordinated honey ranges, with body proportions suited to different label layouts and pack sizes.
aluminium-cap-pet-honey-jars.artwork: Coordinate label colors with the proposed cap finish and confirm a physical color sample before production.
aluminium-cap-pet-honey-jars.packing: Protect the metal cap finish against rubbing and specify whether lids ship fitted or separately.
aluminium-cap-pet-honey-jars.question: Does the aluminum cap include an induction seal?
aluminium-cap-pet-honey-jars.answer: An aluminum cap alone does not identify the liner or sealing system. Include the required seal in the inquiry and approve the complete assembly.

round-pet-honey-jars.headline: Round Jar Labeling & Closure Selection
round-pet-honey-jars.application: The round footprint supports conventional filling, labeling and carton layouts. Shoulder shape and assembled height influence label placement, shelf presentation and case packing across the size range.
round-pet-honey-jars.artwork: Check the label seam and usable area below the shoulders on each selected model.
round-pet-honey-jars.packing: Confirm whether the packing figures cover jar bodies or assembled packs before comparing freight volume.
round-pet-honey-jars.question: Are the PP caps shared across these jars?
round-pet-honey-jars.answer: Do not assume interchangeability from the material alone. Obtain the complete neck drawing and matched closure for each jar model.

mini-glass-honey-jar-shapes.headline: Mini Glass Jar Shapes for Honey Gift Sets
mini-glass-honey-jar-shapes.application: Compare 80 ml and 100 ml glass jars for tasting and gift ranges. Shape and lid dimensions help determine how each jar sits inside the finished presentation.
mini-glass-honey-jar-shapes.artwork: Choose the gift-box arrangement first, then check the visible label area on each jar shape.
mini-glass-honey-jar-shapes.packing: Approve the lid and jar together inside protective inserts rather than sizing the box from capacity alone.
mini-glass-honey-jar-shapes.question: Can these jars use the same gift-box insert?
mini-glass-honey-jar-shapes.answer: Their heights and body profiles differ. Test each assembled jar in the insert, including lid clearance and protection between glass surfaces.

honey-bottle-360ml.headline: 360 ml PET Bottle for Approx. 500 g Honey Packs
honey-bottle-360ml.application: The 360 ml capacity provides the volume reference for an approximate 500 g honey fill trial. The approved drawing defines the usable label area, body proportions and cap interface before artwork is finalized.
honey-bottle-360ml.artwork: The approved drawing defines the usable label panel and artwork dimensions. An actual-size label proof checks placement and alignment on the physical bottle.
honey-bottle-360ml.packing: Bottle dimensions, closure assembly and carton specifications provide the basis for outer-packaging and shipping calculations.
honey-bottle-360ml.question: Does the image show the final bottle design?
honey-bottle-360ml.answer: The approved product drawing and physical sample define the order specification, including the bottle shape, cap, colors and dimensions.

oval-honey-bottles.headline: Oval Bottle Grip, Labels & Closures
oval-honey-bottles.application: The oval cross-section provides broad front and back label areas with a comfortable side grip. The 350 ml and 360 ml formats support similar fill targets while offering different cap and presentation options.
oval-honey-bottles.artwork: Proof front and back labels against each oval profile, including the transition into the shoulders.
oval-honey-bottles.packing: Confirm the final cap configuration before using the catalog packing data for either model.
oval-honey-bottles.question: How do the two oval formats compare?
oval-honey-bottles.answer: Compare the 350 ml and 360 ml capacities, assembled dimensions and closure samples. Their similar volumes do not mean the cap arrangements are identical.

flip-top-honey-bottle-caps.headline: Flip-Top Dispensing for Upright Honey Bottles
flip-top-honey-bottle-caps.application: The attached lid supports one-handed opening and stays with the pack during use. Outlet diameter and bottle squeeze response determine the honey stream and dispensing speed.
flip-top-honey-bottle-caps.artwork: Coordinate the cap color with the bottle, label and brand palette after approving the physical color sample.
flip-top-honey-bottle-caps.packing: Specify whether caps are packed separately or applied to bottles, together with carton quantities and protection for hinges.
flip-top-honey-bottle-caps.question: Can one flip-top cap fit different honey bottles?
flip-top-honey-bottle-caps.answer: Only when the complete neck finish and closure specification match. Approve the cap on each selected bottle rather than choosing by diameter alone.

pointed-nozzle-honey-caps.headline: Narrow Nozzle Caps for Controlled Honey Dispensing
pointed-nozzle-honey-caps.application: The tapered nozzle concentrates the honey stream for directional serving and controlled decoration. Outlet diameter, bottle flexibility and honey viscosity work together to determine flow.
pointed-nozzle-honey-caps.artwork: Confirm cap color against the labeled bottle under the lighting used for approval.
pointed-nozzle-honey-caps.packing: Protect tapered outlets from deformation and contamination; confirm whether caps ship separately or assembled.
pointed-nozzle-honey-caps.question: How do I choose the nozzle opening?
pointed-nozzle-honey-caps.answer: Compare samples with your honey at the intended serving temperature. The opening, bottle squeeze response and closure fit must be evaluated together.

inverted-honey-bottle-valve-caps.headline: Supporting Valve Caps for Cap-Down Honey Bottles
inverted-honey-bottle-valve-caps.application: The closure forms the standing base of an inverted bottle. Its wide profile supports cap-down stability, while the optional valve controls dispensing and helps the outlet reclose after use.
inverted-honey-bottle-valve-caps.artwork: Coordinate closure color with the bottle and label after approving the assembled cap-down presentation.
inverted-honey-bottle-valve-caps.packing: Confirm whether caps and valves are supplied assembled and how the closure is protected during shipment.
inverted-honey-bottle-valve-caps.question: Is a silicone valve included in every inverted cap?
inverted-honey-bottle-valve-caps.answer: No. Valve inclusion and specification depend on the selected closure. List the valve as a separate confirmed component in the quotation and sample approval.

plastic-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.headline: Plastic Screw Caps for Wide-Mouth PET Honey Jars
plastic-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.application: The ribbed skirt provides grip for repeated opening and reclosure on wide-mouth PET jars. Liner and seal choices support the required sealing surface and filling process.
plastic-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.artwork: Choose cap color with the jar and label sample; molded and printed color references should be approved separately.
plastic-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.packing: State whether caps ship loose or applied and identify any liner or seal in the packing list.
plastic-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.question: Can I select a PP cap by jar diameter?
plastic-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.answer: Jar diameter is not enough. Confirm the complete thread and neck finish, sealing surface and the matched physical sample.

metal-twist-off-honey-jar-lids.headline: Metal Twist-Off Lids for Glass Honey Jars
metal-twist-off-honey-jar-lids.application: The lug pattern engages the matching glass finish with a partial turn. Sealing compound, application conditions and jar-rim quality determine the finished closure performance.
metal-twist-off-honey-jar-lids.artwork: Approve the lacquer color and finish on a physical lid sample together with the labeled glass jar.
metal-twist-off-honey-jar-lids.packing: Protect lacquered lid surfaces from scratching and confirm whether lids are packed separately or applied.
metal-twist-off-honey-jar-lids.question: Are gold and black lids interchangeable across glass jars?
metal-twist-off-honey-jar-lids.answer: No. Appearance does not establish compatibility. Match the lid specification, lug pattern and sealing system to the selected jar.

aluminum-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.headline: Aluminum Screw Caps for a Metallic Jar Finish
aluminum-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.application: The aluminum shell gives PET jars a metallic presentation while retaining a threaded opening format. The liner supports the sealing surface, and the cap finish coordinates with the jar label.
aluminum-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.artwork: Approve silver, gold or another available finish with the jar and label presentation.
aluminum-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.packing: Specify liner, cap finish, separate or assembled packing and protection against surface damage.
aluminum-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.question: Can an aluminum cap replace a plastic cap on the same jar?
aluminum-screw-caps-for-honey-jars.answer: Only after confirming the thread, liner and application requirements. Request an assembled sample for the exact jar before changing cap material.
